subject: Hospitality
title: The 10-5 Rule of Hospitality
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The 10-5 Rule of Hospitality.

hook.text: At 10 feet, make eye contact and smile. At 5 feet, greet them verbally. The 10-5 Rule turns every staff member into a host.

buildup.text: Ritz-Carlton and Four Seasons train every employee—from housekeepers to engineers—in the 10-5 Rule.

discovery.text: Guests who receive multiple warm acknowledgments rate their stay 20% higher—even when room quality and food stay the same.

twist.text: The rule doesn't work if it's robotic. 'Good morning' in a flat monotone is worse than silence.

climax.text: The 10-5 Rule builds a culture, not just a behavior. Hotels where everyone greets guests feel fundamentally different.

punchline.text: Eye contact at 10 feet, greeting at 5. Simple rule, profound impact on every guest.

quiz.question: What is the 10-5 Rule in hospitality?
options: At 10 feet make eye contact; at 5 feet greet verbally—applied by all staff
